cases.name: Latron Prime
referenceLimitations: the projectile's BOUNCES are not counted. It bounces at most three times and the fourth contact ends it, a long flight ends it too, and each bounce is a REFLECTION off whatever it touched rather than a hop to the next enemy — so off a body that the collision just killed with a weak-point hit it leaves almost straight up, which is where most of them go. This plane has no surfaces to reflect off, so the shot is scored where it lands; in a tight corridor the bounces are worth up to three more collisions and three more explosions, and this number is a FLOOR
